children: BUTLER NATIONAL CORP reported results for the 2026 quarter with revenue rising to $30.78M and diluted EPS of $0.08, driven by a strong rebound in Aerospace activity and higher overall margins versus the prior-year quarter.
¹ Reported as “Total revenues”. ² Reported as “Net Income”. ³ Reported as “Diluted Earnings Per Common Share”.
Aerospace drove the quarter, with Aerospace revenue up 92% sequentially to $21.7M and a stronger mix of modifications and kit sales boosting margins.
Backlog in Aerospace stood at $51.1M as the company ramped engineering and production capacity and increased internal parts fabrication.
New STC approvals and deliveries of Challenger 605/650 special-mission aircraft expanded the company’s special-mission offerings.
Professional Services remained steady while gaming showed modest growth; headcount increased in Aerospace to support program ramp and planned investments in STCs, equipment and facilities.
